scope: NASA direct RUL few-shot; architecture unchanged
fresh_run_requirement: Use a fresh isolated checkout with the required inputs. Existing output directories resume saved candidates and immutable protocols; never overwrite an earlier protocol to relabel a run.
remote_full_weights: Two selected nonzero-step full-weight checkpoints remain on home desktop. remote_weights_inventory.json records their paths, byte sizes and SHA256. Local audit checks this inventory and the home-GPU reload evidence; it does not reload those full weights locally.
label_budget: 2 source cells x16 supervised RUL pairs per model, plus all eligible labels of a separate validation cell for model selection. Test cell never used in fitting.
partition_scope: Primary report preserves historical four partitions. Robustness report separately averages all three possible validation choices for each of four test cells.
code_scope: Only new experiment and report scripts plus src/c2_rul_improvement.py; no pretrained architecture or existing experiment source modified.
